In [[3643 BBY]], at [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during its [[Separatist War|civil war]], a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] was '''assigned''' to prevent an ambush that the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatists]] were preparing for a Republic convoy, in the Avilatan Badlands' road. The Sergeant was able to defeat the few Separatists there were, and disarm the bombs they had placed along the road, therefore preventing a bloodbath for the Republic side.<ref name="TA" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The mission in the Avilatan Badlands appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The mission represents the events of the [[Republic trooper]] class story mission "The Ambush", where the player is sent by [[Aric Jorgan]], to clear the road for separatists and preventing their ambush on the Republic convoy, having to disarm several bombs along the road.
